tools.name: jostle_list_users
tools.description: List the users in the Jostle instance with their id, username and display name. Use the id or username when you create or update a task. Jostle API: GET /v2/people.

tools.name: jostle_list_presets
tools.description: List the Jostle list presets (named groups of users for assignees or collaborators). Use a preset id when you create a task. Jostle API: GET /v2/people/list-presets.

tools.name: jostle_get_task
tools.description: Get one task by id: title, description, due date, assignee, collaborators, completion status and comment count. The token user must be the assignee or a collaborator. Jostle API: GET /v2/tasks/task/{id}.

tools.name: jostle_list_task_comments
tools.description: List the comments on a task, newest page first, with paging. Jostle API: GET /v2/tasks/task/{id}/comments.

tools.name: jostle_create_task
tools.description: Create a task in the Tasks of one assignee. Give the assignee as userId, username or employeeId, and optional collaborators or a preset. Due dates are saved in Eastern Standard Time. Jostle API: POST /v2/tasks.

tools.name: jostle_update_task
tools.description: Change a task with JSON Patch operations (RFC 6902). Allowed paths: /title, /description, /dueDate, /assignee, /collaborators, /completionStatus. Jostle API: PATCH /v2/tasks/task/{id}.

tools.name: jostle_add_task_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a task as the token user. Comments are visible to everyone who can see the task. Jostle API: POST /v2/tasks/task/{id}/comment.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: jostle_get_task, jostle_list_task_comments · Private data: jostle_get_task, jostle_add_task_comment · Public sink: jostle_create_task, jostle_add_task_comment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: jostle_get_task, jostle_list_task_comments · Private data: jostle_get_task, jostle_add_task_comment · Public sink: jostle_create_task, jostle_add_task_comment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
